title: Nazi-Maruttash
summary: Ruler listed in CFAH-15 Table 4 (Kassite Dynasty).
description: Ruler of Kassite Dynasty. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-15 (Table 4, "Kassite Kings Contemporary with Egyptian Dynasty 18"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Reign: 22 + x; Start: 890; End: 866). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-15: Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon," OSF preprint v1.4 (2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/VYNJU, file CFAH-15 Sumer, Akkad, and Babylon_v1.4.pdf, Table 4 "Kassite Kings Contemporary with Egyptian Dynasty 18", pp. 37–38
reign.note: Row "[Nazi-Maruttash, aka Adad-šuma-uṣur]" of Table 4 (Kassite Dynasty). The table prints the name with square brackets (restored or uncertain).
